summary: Victim joined a Discord community promoting fake crypto launch opportunities and received small early payouts after sending SOL to developer wallets. The operators later displayed fabricated high returns from a supposed influencer launch and demanded additional gas fee payments before withdrawals while blocking access to funds.
user_mistake: sent increasing amounts of cryptocurrency to unverified investment operators after receiving small initial payouts
prevention: refuse investment schemes promising guaranteed multiplier returns/do not pay additional fees to unlock supposed profits
